baseFrontend: single v82 NexoWatt native shell runtime built from the ioBroker Admin functional core
label: v82
notes: The browser loads one v82 module-federation runtime and the NexoWatt-native React navigation.
Core navigation labels and icons are rendered in Drawer.tsx, not injected after render.
The legacy eos-branding and eos-security DOM overlays are no longer loaded.
The native ObjectBrowser and direct-control semantics remain the functional datapoint core.
changes: Introduced NexoWattNavIcon.tsx and native Drawer/DrawerItem integration.
Introduced a small shell coordinator for layout, logo and navigation container only.
Introduced a minimal security API without page-wide click interception.
Removed passive console and object helper scripts from the browser entry point.
Reduced navigation DOM work to stable container classes; native React owns labels, icons, focus and clicks.
